title: CD3 / Million Women Study — recruitment variables (schemify pilot) — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

not_on_questionnaire.title: Not on questionnaire
not_on_questionnaire.description: Adopted verbatim from the source's own code lists (millionwomenstudydatadictionary-v1-21.xlsx, 'Recruitment variables' sheet), where -1 documents that the question was not asked in a given questionnaire version. Confirmed against the sheet's own Availability columns (Aqua/Blue/Other): every field carrying this code shows 'No' availability for exactly one version (Blue).

missing_numeric.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_numeric.description: The source lists no distinguishing code for why a value is absent -- agent-decided, mirroring the sibling Generations and OFH pilot packages' policy for genuinely undifferentiated missingness. Open for steward confirmation at review.
